description: Controlled-motion baseline (PR-VID-MOTION-410). Unexecuted template: bind your own images and driving videos, and a physical run needs the owner's separate authorization. Full 81-frame group: sit down, turn around and walk forward, two subjects each, three arms (18 jobs).

cases.prompt: a person standing in a plain, evenly lit studio, full body, seen from the front, photorealistic

motion.action: Lowers from standing to seated on a chair.
motion.motion_prompt: the person lowers themselves from standing and sits down on a chair
motion.expected_outcome: The intended subject's hips lower and they finish seated, still in frame; it is the subject who sits, not a second figure, and the background does not move in their place.

cases.prompt: a person standing in a plain, evenly lit studio, full body, seen from the front, photorealistic

motion.action: Turns in place through about 180 degrees to face away from the camera.
motion.motion_prompt: the person turns around on the spot until their back is to the camera
motion.expected_outcome: The intended subject rotates about 180 degrees in place and finishes with their back to the camera; the body does not travel across the scene and no second figure turns instead.

cases.prompt: a person standing in a plain, evenly lit studio, full body, seen from the front, photorealistic

motion.action: Walks forward toward the camera for several steps.
motion.motion_prompt: the person walks forward toward the camera taking several steps
motion.expected_outcome: The intended subject takes at least three visible steps toward the camera and grows larger or closer in frame; background motion or a second walking figure does not count as success.
